review_type: Read-only static source and README audit; implementation not changed, no converter/test code executed
freeze_coordination: Code agent confirmed initial89b6d5e... freeze, then confirmed only explicit streamed NUL refusal and README changed to finalef5bb6b...; final source hash was independently checked before report.

checks.area: No overwrite, including output aliases and publication races
checks.evidence: lstat rejects every existing destination directory entry, including dangling symlinks and hardlinks. Final os.link(...,follow_symlinks=False) atomically fails with EEXIST if a competing output entry appears; there is no replace/rename-overwrite fallback.

checks.area: Input read only and regular-file boundary
checks.evidence: Source is opened O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK, fstat must be regular, and no source write/truncate/replace occurs. Existing same-name or hardlinked output entries are rejected by destination lstat. Ordinary size/mtime changes abort before publication.

Same-directory mkstemp supplies a private temporary file; fchmod reinforces0600. Output flush/fsync occurs before publication. finally removes the temporary name for both success and conversion exceptions, and restores the previous csv field-size limit. The final hard link refers to the completed0600 inode.

Positive integer limits; initial input stat and counted streamed bytes enforce100MiB default even if source grows. csv.field_size_limit enforces1Mi characters per field, header count is capped at10000, and BoundedWriter counts actual UTF8 serialization bytes against200MiB default before writing. Rows are not accumulated.

UTF8-sig with strict decoding; newline="" and csv.reader strict=True support quoted newlines and configurable distinct delimiters/quote characters. Binary NUL is explicitly rejected in the byte reader across Python versions. Empty/blank/exact-duplicate headers and row-width mismatch reject before final output; JSON serialization preserves logical string values and escapes data.

checks.area: No execution, network or formula interpretation
checks.evidence: Only standard-library CSV/JSON, file and CLI operations are imported. No eval/exec, subprocess, shell, network client or dependency installer exists. Formula/HTML-looking cells remain JSON strings. README explicitly disclaims sanitizing spreadsheets and universal safety.

verification_not_performed_here: No CSV conversion or filesystem race harness run
No dependency install, network call or external command from the reviewed program
declared_limits: Static audit is not a general security certification.
Publishing requires the documented same-directory hardlink-capable filesystem.
Source size/mtime checks are not an immutable input snapshot or concurrent-writer locking protocol.
